name: Poor High / Poor Low Repair
note: Builds a real TPO profile from each completed RTH session - rows row_frac * daily ATR wide, every 30-minute period marking every row between its own low and high - and records a POOR extreme when the top two occupied rows each carry min_tpo periods and at least flat_n periods have their high within one row of the session high (a flat, tail-less top). Unrepaired extremes are carried for reg_depth sessions; the trade is TOWARD the level, taken when price comes within approach * ATRd of it on a bar that closes in the direction of the level, targeting repair * ATRd BEYOND it. A level leaves the register once the auction has traded through it.
source: Dalton, Jones & Dalton, 'Mind Over Markets' (1993). Operational definition as documented by marketcalls.in ('Poor High and Poor Low Market Profile Structure Explained': lack of excess or a single TPO at the tail) and the ShadowTrader glossary ('a poor high will have less than two TPOs of excess with at least 2-3 columns of TPOs lining up to form a flat top').
